subject: Switchover ops & architecture deep-dive — PoC scheduling
messages:
From: Alex Walsh <alex.walsh@nimbushealth.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.inference>
Cc: Kate Jensen <kate.jensen@nimbushealth.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: 60–90m architecture deep-dive for PoC switchover

Hi Markus,

Thanks for taking a look earlier. Were moving forward with a PoC to evaluate switching our inference stack away from our current provider and into a managed platform. Before we sign the SOW we need a technical deep-dive (60-90m) to cover migration approach, runtime constraints, and acceptance criteria.

High-level asks:
- Overview of Redwood runtime and how you handle prefix/KV cache and persistent session strategies
- Latency and cost profiles at our target QPS (well share traces)
- Data handling (retention, logs, encryption in transit/at rest)
- Cutover plan for a staged PoC (canary traffic, rollback points)

Can you share available slots next week? Were flexible on day/time but would prefer early in the week for our ops team. Ive attached our current inference topology for context (nimbus_current_arch.pdf).

Regards,
Alex
Director of Platform Engineering
Nimbus Health

Attachment: nimbus_current_arch.pdf

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.inference>
To: Alex Walsh <alex.walsh@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.inference>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
Date: Wed, 2 Jun 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: 60	60m architecture deep-dive for PoC switchover

Alex — thanks for the context and the topology diagram, thats helpful. Wed be happy to run a focused session that covers the items you listed plus a quick checklist for SLA/observability during the PoC. Proposed format: 20m architecture overview, 25m migration/cutover plan, 20m ops runbook + Q&A + next steps (45-90m total depending on questions).

Available slots (PDT) next week:
- Mon 2027-06-07 09:00-10:30
- Tue 2027-06-08 11:00-12:30 or 14:00-15:30
- Wed 2027-06-09 08:30-10:00

To make the session efficient, can you confirm these pre-reads or items we should prioritize?
- baseline latency/throughput targets and typical sequence lengths
- any compliance constraints beyond SOC2 (e.g., regional data residency)
- whether youll need a temporary dedicated GPU pool for the PoC (we can provision a short-term Reserved slot)

Ive looped in Dev (solutions) and Marissa (PM) to own the runbook and contract touchpoints. If one of the slots works Ill send a calendar invite and a short PoC checklist.

Thanks,
Markus Klein
Head of Solutions — Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood-prelim-slots.ics

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.inference>
To: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.inference>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.inference>
Date: Wed, 2 Jun 2027 10:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: Nimbus PoC — whos leading which sections?

Team — forwarding Alexs request. Quick plan:
- Dev: lead runtime/bench and demo of prefix/KV cache behavior + spike test plan
- Marissa: own the PoC checklist, SOW touchpoints, and calendar invite/DocuSign follow-up
- Lauren: commercial/contract escalation point (if Nimbus asks for committed capacity/discount)

Dev + Marissa, please prepare 1 slide each and a 1-page runbook we can share ahead of the meeting. Ill be the primary presenter for the architecture overview.

On Wed, 2 Jun 2027 at 09:12 Alex Walsh <alex.walsh@nimbushealth.com> wrote:
> Hi Markus,
> 
> Thanks for taking a look earlier. Were moving forward with a PoC...

Markus

From: Alex Walsh <alex.walsh@nimbushealth.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.inference>
Cc: Kate Jensen <kate.jensen@nimbushealth.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Jun 2027 08:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: 60	60m architecture deep-dive for PoC switchover

Markus — thanks for the quick reply and suggested slots. Tue 2027-06-08 11:00-12:30 PDT works for our team. Two quick asks before the call:
1) We require an executed mutual NDA before detailed logs and production traces change hands — can you send a DocuSign link or confirm you accept our standard mutual NDA?
2) Can Redwood provision a short-term dedicated pool for the PoC (estimate: 1-2 A100-equivalent GPUs for three weeks)? We want to measure parity under sustained load.

If youd like, we can share a sanitized trace and a short CSV of sequence-length distribution ahead of time.

Best,
Alex

Attachment: (none)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
To: Alex Walsh <alex.walsh@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.inference>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.inference>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.inference>
Date: Thu, 3 Jun 2027 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Confirmed: PoC switchover deep-dive + pre-read & NDA

Alex — confirmed Tue 2027-06-08 11:00-12:30 PDT. Ive sent a calendar invite (link in HubSpot). Please find the short PoC checklist attached (redwood-poc-checklist.pdf).

On the NDA: we can sign yours and return a countersigned copy; Ive attached our standard mutual NDA as a placeholder but were happy to countersign (DocuSign link below). Once we have an executed NDA well accept a sanitized trace by email.

Regarding the dedicated pool: we can provision a temporary dedicated pool for the PoC. Ill open a ticket with infra to reserve 2x A100-equivalent units for the 3-week window you specified; Ill confirm allocation by EOD Monday. Notes for the call:
- Dev will demo cache behavior and bench plan
- Markus will cover routing/fallback and rollout policy (canary)
- Ill cover SOW milestones and acceptance criteria

DocuSign (NDA): https://www.docusign.com/placeholder/nimbus-nnda
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/12345/view/67890

Attachments: redwood-poc-checklist.pdf, nda_signed.pdf

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Principal Product Manager — Redwood Inference
